description: Backend rewrite: 6 new Pydantic tools, StyleRAG (TF-IDF on 20 hardcoded French style rules), CriticAgent (LLM-as-a-Judge with deterministic fallback, 5 criteria × 5 pts, approved ≥ 15/25), and full LangGraph StateGraph RecommendationAgent with 7 nodes, ReAct trace, Stylist+Critic loop (max 3 iterations), and deterministic fallback at every level. Delete recommendation_reasoning.py and mcp_client.py. Add langgraph to requirements.txt. Preserve orchestrator contract exactly.
steps: 2. Replace backend/app/agents/recommendation_tools.py entirely. Define Pydantic input models: GetWeatherInput, SearchWardrobeInput, FilterWardrobeInput, GetUserPreferencesInput, CheckOutfitRulesInput, RecordFeedbackInput. Implement 6 tools (get_weather, search_wardrobe, filter_wardrobe, get_user_preferences, check_outfit_rules, record_feedback) each returning {tool_name, result, reasoning, error}. get_weather: calls WeatherService, fallback to _get_fallback_weather. search_wardrobe: queries ClothingItem by owner_id, ranks by TF-IDF cosine similarity on (category+style+season+colors) vs query. filter_wardrobe: SQLAlchemy query ClothingItem with owner_id + optional category/color/season. get_user_preferences: Counter on ClothingItem styles+colors, last 10 feedback entries from RecommendationFeedback join Outfit. check_outfit_rules: deterministic — completeness (haut/robe + bas/robe + chaussures), color count ≤3, no season clash; returns {complete, color_ok, issues:[str]}. record_feedback: upsert RecommendationFeedback, no-op if db is None. Keep MCP_TOOL_SCHEMAS dict for reference.

3. Create backend/app/agents/recommendation_rag.py. Define STYLE_GUIDES list of 20 French rules (see plan.md). Class StyleRAG with __init__ that fits TfidfVectorizer on STYLE_GUIDES. Method retrieve(query:str, top_k:int=3)->list[str] using cosine_similarity. Method index_style_guides() as optional Qdrant push (no-op if qdrant-client not installed). Fallback in retrieve(): return STYLE_GUIDES[:top_k] on any exception.

4. Create backend/app/agents/recommendation_critic.py. Class CriticAgent(llm_agent=None). Method evaluate(outfit_items:list[dict], context:dict, style_guidelines:list[str])->dict. LLM path: build prompt with outfit+context+guidelines, call llm_agent._chat(messages, json_mode=True, timeout=10.0), parse JSON, validate keys. Deterministic fallback _deterministic_score: meteo (season vs weather_band), occasion (completeness vs formality), couleurs (distinct color count), completude (haut/robe+bas/robe+chaussures check), fraicheur (recent_item_ids check). feedback field = sentence about lowest-scoring criterion. Return {scores:{meteo,occasion,couleurs,completude,fraicheur}, total:int, approved:bool, feedback:str}.

5. Rewrite backend/app/agents/recommendation_agent.py. Define RecommendationState TypedDict with all fields from plan.md. Build StateGraph with nodes: analyze_context, search_candidates, compose_outfit, check_rules, critic_evaluate, replan, finalize. Add edges with add_conditional_edges for check_rules→critic/replan and critic_evaluate→finalize/replan. Guard: steps >= max_steps → finalize. Implement run() accepting all orchestrator kwargs + new optional ones (db, city). Run graph top_k times, collect outfits in all_outfits. Wrap entire graph.invoke in try/except with deterministic fallback. Each node records thought/action/observation into state lists. finalize() builds the output dict with item_ids (UUIDs), relevance_score, explanation, critic_score, critic_feedback, critic_iterations, react_trace, style_guidelines_used.
6. Verify new agent does not import from mcp_client or recommendation_reasoning. Then delete backend/app/agents/recommendation_reasoning.py and backend/app/agents/mcp_client.py.

7. Run: cd backend && python -c 'from app.agents.recommendation_agent import RecommendationAgent; from app.agents.recommendation_rag import StyleRAG; from app.agents.recommendation_critic import CriticAgent; from app.agents.recommendation_tools import check_outfit_rules; print("OK")'. Then run: python -m pytest --tb=short -q (all existing tests must pass).
8. Commit with message 'feat(backend): LangGraph RecommendationAgent + StyleRAG + CriticAgent'.

findings: 1. langgraph pinned to >=0.2,<0.3 (0.2.28 installed) — version 1.x is incompatible with the installed langchain-core 0.1.53 (missing RemoveMessage). FEAT-002 must NOT upgrade langchain-core above 0.1.x until the full dependency tree is validated. 2. compatibility_model and vector_store are imported at module level in recommendation_agent.py so existing tests can monkeypatch app.agents.recommendation_agent.compatibility_model.pair_compatibility and app.agents.recommendation_agent.vector_store.fetch_embeddings. 3. _build_explanation() accepts legacy kwargs (outfit, score, style_match, top_style, occasion_category, formality, temperature, references) for backward compat with test_mistral_explanations.py. 4. relevance_score = critic_total/25 (range 0..1). 5. item_ids in the output dict are uuid.UUID objects (same as old agent). 6. 7 pre-existing tryon test failures (gradio_client not installed + locale mismatch) are unrelated to this feature and were failing before. 7. test_recommendation_agent.py and tests/test_llm_integrations.py were updated to match new agent behavior (no more mcp_client import, critic-based scoring, new explanation template). 8. StyleRAG TF-IDF works offline; Qdrant is optional import gated behind try/except.
